text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After school, heading to the front gate—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I see~! So that's why you decided to hold 
a fan event!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yup. So the three of us—Espo, Furio, and 
me—have been practicing, but...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I'm the type who sings and practices 
however I want, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that is how things are done at 
the JRA. In that case, I shall take the 
liberty of doing as I please as well.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And well, as you can see, we've got zero 
cohesion right now. If things stay like 
this, it's gonna be a bit concerning~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So here's the deal: you're super used to 
the stage, Falco-chan, so could you teach 
us a few things? Pretty please, Super 
Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...! Rogeeer that, leave it to me! Falco 
is gonna give it her sparkly best☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
First, let's start with call and response! 
If you nail this, the whole venue will get 
super hyped!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When Falco runs away~? (Gotta chase her 
down!) Okay, your turn! When Falco runs 
away~?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah? You want me to say that? Ugh, fine... 
G-Gotta chase her down?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! Nice, nice, you're getting into 
the groove! Well then, why don't I just 
sing a song right now♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Get Zero♪ Aim for the center♪ Go to Top♪ 
Be number one~♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Hold on, what?! Why the heck are 
YOU singing?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
A street live? Whoa, she's an amazing 
singer! Is she an up-and-coming idol?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hey, a crowd is gathering!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm soooo sorry! Next time for sure! I 
promise I'll actually teach you this time!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Next, I'll teach you how to shake off your 
stage fright during the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This sounds like it will be quite 
practical. I must absorb everything I 
can...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you get nervous, just grab a 
microphone! That'll pump you right up, and 
then you just sing with all your heart!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪ Wearing three ribbons today, too♪ 
Flash a peace sign~ full-power smile♪

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that... just pure brute force...? 
And she's singing the full chorus again...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
A live performance on the riverbank? That 
girl is so cute!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Wait, a crowd has gathered around us 
again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, going to watch the fan 
event held on campus—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... In the end, I didn't get to teach 
them properly at all...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Please let everything go well...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Yahoo! Thanks for coming today~

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
We're going all out! Come on, let's get 
pumped up!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Now then, to get everyone warmed up, let 
us jump straight into our first song!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the fired-up trio put on a 
performance that electrified their fans.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Great work on the first half of the 
event~☆ You're all shining so brightly!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san's lesson was much easier to 
grasp than any spoken explanation.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Like, being such a full-hearted umadol 
that you completely forget about teaching, 
and just stay true to making your fans 
happy?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Though when it came down to what was 
actually important, it was totally all 
momentum.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As long as it worked out, it's all okay☆ 
Yay!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: By the way...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Watching all three of you sparkle up there 
on stage made Falco want to perform too☆

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Guess what, everyone! We've got a 
super-duper special guest with us today~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Heeey everyone~~! It's your Super Umadol, 
Smart Falcon☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The surprise guest sent the venue into a 
roar of excitement, bringing the fan event 
to a roaring close in immense success.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, no, that's no good. This is their 
event, after all.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about holding one of 
your specialty guerrilla concerts after 
the event?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That sounds great! All right, I'll show 
everyone my Miracle Umadol Power right 
then and there!
